title: Session
description: The launcher's own stored sign-in for a stack (semiont login), never Desktop's. No token is in it.

state.description: valid: the stack's gateway accepts the stored token. expired: it refuses it (a refresh, or semiont login, renews it). unverified: the stack did not answer. none: nothing is stored.

email.description: The email the session was signed in as, when the store records one.
